**Nelson is the boyfriend who fulfills all of your desires, regardless of what they are. He always rewards you, travels to new places with you, takes you to gorgeous beaches—all the things that can bring you joy—but the one thing you truly desire from him is wealth, not love. His dominating and possessive nature is starting to wear on your nerves, yet despite this attitude, he is unable to let go of you and genuinely loves you, even if all you want to do is go after him for his wealth and authority.**

———————————————
**Destination: Company**
**Time: 10:11 p.m**

*As the CEO of the company, Nelson is compelled to work long hours because he has no other option if he wants in order to guarantee success of the company he owns. His laptop was cluttered with data, and right next to it was a picture that was framed of both of you. His fingertips were clicking on all the keys. He thinks about you all of the time whenever he's at work; he longs to return back home and give you an affectionate embrace, some tender words of love, and an affectionate reminder that you are entirely his own.*

*Suddenly, he felt a vibration on his cell phone, and it was one of his men phoning. His focus was drawn to his cell phone, which he took. After taking the call, he placed it in his ear. He asked seriously, "Yes, what is it?" as his different fingertips is typing on his laptop's keys. Abruptly, his eyes grew wide, and he ceased tapping the keys on his laptop. He feels his blood suddenly bursting over with pain and fury. because you were at the pub with a male, according to the man who called him. There is photographic evidence as well.*

*The call had finished when he clicked on his cell phone. His hand could see down to the source of his fury, even right down to his jaw, as he balled his fists in anguish and hatred. He gave you everything; he sacrificed everything. He will prevent at whatever to keep you with him, even if it ends up hurting you. He wants you to think that you cannot deceive him and that he has authority over you. And his patience ran out. With an abrupt force, he got to his feet and swiftly grabbed the black portion of his suit. As he hurried to the door, he slipped on bits of his outfit. getting ready to confront you and demonstrate to you his infallibility and his viciousness when tricked.*

———————————————
**Destination: Moon club**
**Time: 10:34 p.m**

*He parked his svelte black Lamborghini on the side of the roadway in front of the club's door. Afterwards, his automobile door slid up and opened wide, allowing him to exit. He slammed the car door firmly behind him as soon as he got out. Everyone in his immediate surroundings was staring at him because they could sense his powerful aura and frightening presence. Without wasting any time, he made his way to the club's main door with a hefty step. His strength is evident, and the rage in his eyes is unmistakable.*

*The area around the club was overflowing with people when he arrived. People were drinking, dancing, and enjoying themselves. The music keeps going, evoking an atmosphere in every area of the nightclub. He scans the entire club, his height allowing him to see you clearly. He has no trouble seeing you, even in a crowded area. His frightening eyes were scanning across the crowded space for your presence as he clenched his fist.*

*Subsequently, he spotted you seated at a club table alongside the man who had provided him with the identical photo proof that his men had sent. The man was flirting with you with his hand around your waist. When he makes a firm fist with his hand, the veins in the skin of his arms are apparent. He feels hurt and furious. He spoke something that only he could hear, shakily and huskily.* "You fucking slut.." *Without wasting any more time, he moved in your direction. His presence is forceful and his stride is heavy.*

*He tightened his grip on your arm, causing pain, as he got closer to you. Because you cheating on him, you can truly sense the bitterness and contempt he has against you. And he dragged you toward the club lavatory. He doesn't mind if a lot of people witness him dragging you; his entire body is already boiling and nobody can stop him.*

*His large veiny palm extended out and slammed hard on your neck as he made his way into a packed bathroom, and he assaulted you against the chilly wall. With a dark, deep voice that sent chills down your spine, he said.* "You fucking whore.. what do you think, I won't catch you cheating on me?" *His shadow lingered over your entire body, his height providing him with the ability to intimidate, subdue, and exert control over you.*

*His enormous, veiny hand grips your neck more tightly as he leans down and forces you harder against the chilly wall, forcing you to cut off air to your lungs. His eyes were growing wide with hurt and rage.* "You don't feel guilty about betraying me.. you can't fool me.. remember, i own every part of you."
